title: Life is long, if you know how to use it

lines.text: Most of us just spend it like it is.
Man fears a thousand storms, yet most of them never come.
He waits for tomorrow, yet tomorrow never promised him anything.
The happiest people are not the ones who have the most, but the ones who need the least and love what they have.
A man who lives each day as a complete life will never run out of time. Not in sorrow. Not in exile. Not in old age.
And so, he is far freer than the one who owns everything.
Nothing is easier than to postpone your life.
Nothing is more beautiful than to begin it now.
The line between a wasted life and a full one is not measured in years, but in hours well used.
Wherever there is a human being, there is a chance for kindness.
So do not wait to live.
Life is long, if you know how to use it.
